docs.summary: File-level metadata captured from the source: format identification, generator strings, copyright, and any unmodeled root extensions (e.g. VRM JSON).

members.name: Format
members.signature: public required string Format { get; init; }

docs.summary: Format version string when available, e.g. `"2.0"` for glTF, `"7400"` for FBX.
Tool that produced the file (glTF `asset.generator`, FBX `FBXHeaderExtension.Creator`, etc.).
Copyright string declared by the source, if any.

members.name: RawExtensions
members.signature: public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement> RawExtensions { get; init; }

docs.summary: Unmodeled root-level extension data. For glTF this is the contents of `extensions` on the top-level asset (e.g. `VRMC_vrm`, `VRMC_springBone`).

members.name: Extras
members.signature: public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Extras { get; init; }

docs.summary: Other free-form metadata (FBX user properties at scene level, glTF `asset.extras`, ...).
